desc:
STAY ALIVE 🔪

Can you survive Bon the Rabbit from The Walten Files? Enter a terrifying multiplayer horror hide and seek survival game where a smart and relentless killer AI hunts you down. Bon is always searching, and nowhere is truly safe.

🔪 ESCAPE & SURVIVE -- Run, hide, and escape Bon the Rabbit
🧠 SMART KILLER AI -- Bon will hunt you down wherever you go.
👥 MULTIPLAYER SURVIVAL -- Team up with friends or sabotage other players to survive longer.
🏆 BE THE LAST SURVIVOR -- Compete against others and prove your survival skills.
⚡ UNLOCK CLASSES -- Buy powerful classes, upgrade your abilities, and become stronger.
🐰 Will you survive Bon, or become his next victim?
